title: SharePoint: Copilot in SharePoint, with advanced work billed in Copilot Credits
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents a beta Microsoft Graph API for creating spending policies, so the claim that this automation is not documented is incorrect. The roadmap facts, licensing split, site controls and retirement date are supported; a few navigation and documentation differences need qualification.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery affects discovery without changing existing permissions or direct access.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery requires Copilot licensing and SharePoint Advanced Management availability.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery changes require propagation time.
claims.quote: Because the setting must propagate across indexing systems, updates can take time to become fully effective.
